Applied Scientist I, Example Devices

Job ID: 1060 | Example Corp Services LLC | Sunnyvale, California, USA

DESCRIPTION

The Example Devices team builds the on-device models that make our tablets faster and more useful. As an Applied Scientist I you will work on ranking and recommendation models for the home screen, from problem framing to the experiment that ships.

You will partner with engineers and product managers, write production-quality Python, and present your results to the team every sprint.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, train, and evaluate models for ranking and personalization.
  • Build the offline evaluation and online experiment plan for each launch.
  • Write clear documents that explain the approach and its trade-offs.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree or PhD in computer science, statistics, or a related quantitative field, completed by June 2027.
  • Experience with Python and a deep learning framework.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Publications or internship projects in recommendation or ranking.
  • Experience shipping a model to production.

Example Corp is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
